scope: Proposition 5.1 of the manuscript “Strong Ulam Stability Characterizes Amenability” (preprints/Strong-Ulam-Stability-Characterizes-Amenability-October-5-2026/strong-ulam-stability.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 251 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b28d280b0c673c69), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are numerical constants C and h0 > 0 such that, for the construction of Section 4 with h ≤ h0 and 0 < η ≤ 1/4, V {p,q} qp − V {p,q,r} qp ≤ Ch + CNη + CNhη (5.1) for every three configurations p, q, r. The constants do not depend on the cardinalities of any alphabets or on the configurations.
